learningObjective.zh: 學習及練習與 SWEAR 有關的片語動詞。
learningObjective.en: Learn and practise the phrasal verbs related to SWEAR.

register.labelZh: SWEAR 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: SWEAR 片語動詞可以描述以神明之名作出的承諾,以及某人正式就任重要職位的儀式。；swear by 可以表示你非常信賴某種療法、產品、習慣、專家或方法。；swear off 可用來表示某人認真決定戒掉酒精、甜食、能量飲品、購物或其他習慣。；swear to 可以表示某人是否完全肯定;swear somebody to secrecy 或 silence 則表示資料不得外傳。
register.summaryEn: The SWEAR family can describe promises made in God’s name and formal ceremonies in which somebody enters an important position. Swear by lets you show that you believe strongly in a remedy, product, habit, expert or method. Swear off is useful when somebody makes a serious decision to stop alcohol, sweets, energy drinks, shopping or another habit. Swear to can show whether somebody is completely certain. Swear somebody to secrecy or silence shows that information must not be shared.

questions.prompt: My brother strongly believes that lemon and honey drinks are an excellent cold remedy.
questions.promptZh: 我哥哥深信檸檬蜜糖飲品是很好的感冒療法。
questions.answer: My brother swears by lemon and honey drinks as a cold remedy.
questions.answerZh: 我哥哥非常信賴檸檬蜜糖飲品這種感冒療法。

questions.prompt: He officially took the oath of office as president in January.
questions.promptZh: 他在一月正式宣誓就任總統。
questions.answer: He was sworn in as president in January.
questions.answerZh: 他在一月宣誓就任總統。

questions.prompt: He intends to promise that he will stop drinking alcohol.
questions.promptZh: 他打算發誓不再飲酒。
questions.answer: He intends to swear off alcohol.
questions.answerZh: 他打算發誓戒酒。

questions.prompt: The producers made the actors promise not to reveal how the series ends.
questions.promptZh: 監製要求演員承諾不會透露劇集的結局。
questions.answer: The producers swore the actors to secrecy about how the series ends.
questions.answerZh: 監製要求演員發誓對劇集結局保密。

questions.prompt: I think I have met him somewhere before, but I am not completely certain.
questions.promptZh: 我想自己以前曾在某處見過他,但不能完全肯定。
questions.answer: I think I have met him somewhere before, but I could not swear to it.
questions.answerZh: 我想自己以前曾在某處見過他,但不能斷言這是真的。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 斷言某事屬實;完全肯定

questions.prompt: Make a solemn promise before Almighty God that your statement is true.
questions.promptZh: 請在全能的上帝面前莊嚴起誓,保證你的陳述屬實。
questions.answer: Swear by Almighty God that your statement is true.
questions.answerZh: 請以全能的上帝之名起誓,保證你的陳述屬實。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 以神明或某人之名起誓

questions.prompt: At noon, the judge will officially give the new officers their oath.
questions.promptZh: 中午時,法官會正式主持新任人員的宣誓儀式。
questions.answer: At noon, the judge will swear the new officers in.
questions.answerZh: 中午時,法官會主持新任人員宣誓就職。

questions.prompt: Our coach has complete trust in her assistant.
questions.promptZh: 我們的教練完全信任她的助理。
questions.answer: Our coach swears by her assistant.
questions.answerZh: 我們的教練非常信賴她的助理。

questions.prompt: Jeff told me about his promotion and made me promise not to tell anyone.
questions.promptZh: Jeff 告訴我他升職的消息,並要求我承諾不告訴任何人。
questions.answer: Jeff told me about his promotion and swore me to silence.
questions.answerZh: Jeff 告訴我他升職的消息,並要我發誓保持沉默。

questions.prompt: After the terrible flight, Lena promised never to take another helicopter trip.
questions.promptZh: 經歷那次可怕的飛行後,Lena 承諾以後不再乘坐直升機。
questions.answer: After the terrible flight, Lena swore off helicopter trips.
questions.answerZh: 經歷那次可怕的飛行後,Lena 發誓不再乘坐直升機。

questions.prompt: Before speaking, the witness made a solemn promise in God’s name that he would tell the truth.
questions.promptZh: 發言前,證人以上帝之名莊嚴承諾會說出真相。
questions.answer: Before speaking, the witness swore by God that he would tell the truth.
questions.answerZh: 發言前,證人以上帝之名起誓會說出真相。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 以神明或某人之名起誓

questions.prompt: No one could say with certainty exactly when the lights went out.
questions.promptZh: 沒有人能夠肯定地說出燈光究竟在甚麼時候熄滅。
questions.answer: No one could swear to the exact time the lights went out.
questions.answerZh: 沒有人能斷言燈光熄滅的確實時間。

questions.prompt: Since New Year’s Day, Noah has promised not to drink fizzy drinks.
questions.promptZh: 自元旦以來,Noah 已承諾不再喝汽水。
questions.answer: Since New Year’s Day, Noah has sworn off fizzy drinks.
questions.answerZh: 自元旦以來,Noah 已發誓戒掉汽水。

questions.prompt: Can you say with complete certainty what colour the bag was?
questions.promptZh: 你能完全肯定那個袋是甚麼顏色嗎?
questions.answer: Can you swear to the colour of the bag?
questions.answerZh: 你能斷言那個袋的顏色嗎?

questions.prompt: When will the new mayor officially take the oath of office?
questions.promptZh: 新任市長會在甚麼時候正式宣誓就職?
questions.answer: When will the new mayor be sworn in?
questions.answerZh: 新任市長會在甚麼時候宣誓就職?

questions.prompt: Does your father strongly recommend this brand of coffee?
questions.promptZh: 你父親是否非常推薦這個咖啡品牌?

questions.answerZh: 你父親是否非常信賴這個咖啡品牌?

questions.prompt: You must make a solemn promise in God’s name that the information is true before you sign.
questions.promptZh: 簽署前,你必須以上帝之名莊嚴起誓,保證資料屬實。
questions.answer: You must swear by God that the information is true before you sign.
questions.answerZh: 簽署前,你必須以上帝之名起誓,保證資料屬實。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 以神明或某人之名起誓

questions.promptZh: 每個看過新設計的人都被要求承諾不會討論它。
questions.answer: Everyone who saw the new design has been sworn to secrecy.
questions.answerZh: 每個看過新設計的人都被要求發誓保密。

questions.promptZh: 多年來,這名廚師一直非常推薦新鮮薑。
questions.answer: For years, this chef has sworn by fresh ginger.
questions.answerZh: 多年來,這名廚師一直非常信賴新鮮薑。

questions.prompt: Who will officially give the new club captain the oath?
questions.promptZh: 誰會正式主持新任學會隊長的宣誓儀式?
questions.answer: Who will swear the new club captain in?
questions.answerZh: 誰會主持新任學會隊長宣誓就職?

questions.promptZh: 我記得月份,但不能肯定事情發生在哪一天。
questions.answer: I remember the month, but I cannot swear to the exact day.
questions.answerZh: 我記得月份,但不能斷言事情發生的確實日期。

questions.promptZh: 導演為甚麼要求整個團隊承諾保持沉默?

questions.answerZh: 導演為甚麼要求整個團隊發誓保持沉默?

questions.promptZh: 損失了這麼多金錢後,他可能會發誓不再網上購物。
questions.answer: After losing so much money, he may swear off online shopping.
questions.answerZh: 損失了這麼多金錢後,他可能會發誓戒掉網上購物。
